title: One‐pot synthesis of novel 2′‐deoxyuridine derivatives containing α‐aminophosphonate moieties
abstract: AbstractA series of α‐aminophosphonate derivatives of 2′‐deoxyuridine (8a–k) have been prepared from 5′‐O‐tert‐butyldimethylsilyl‐3′‐amino‐2′, 3′‐dideoxyuridine in good yields. The structures of all the products were confirmed by 1H NMR, 31P NMR, 31C NMR, and IR spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry and elemental analyses. © 2007 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 18:230–235, 2007; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.20288
